author: TommoDotCommo
description: Co-op for The Witness by TommoDotCommo. A dev preview: two games on one PC share some panels and doors and show each other as characters; playing with friends over the internet is not possible yet.

needs: Your own copy of The Witness on Steam, build 11370412.
steps: Press Open the mod's page to read how far it is and follow its progress.
tips: It is a dev preview and not playable with friends yet: two copies of the game on one PC can see each other, and some puzzles are shared. It has no installer or release.
